name: @deepseek-ai/dsh-desktop
description: macOS desktop shell for the dsh web GUI — Plan A thin wrapper: spawns the dsh web host and opens it in an Electron window

scripts.smoke: npm run build && DSH_DESKTOP_SMOKE=1 DSH_DESKTOP_HOST="node scripts/fake-host.mjs" DSH_DESKTOP_CWD="." electron .
scripts.pack:dir: npm run build && node scripts/package-host.mjs && electron-builder --dir && node scripts/finish-app.mjs
scripts.pack: npm run build && node scripts/package-host.mjs && electron-builder --dir && node scripts/finish-app.mjs --dmg
